drawPhase: Draw a card from the stock or pick up the discard pile.
discardPhase: Discard a card or go out.
roundEnd: Round over. Proceed to the next round.
goOutReason: Going out requires at least one completed canasta (7-card meld)
selectPair: Select a pair (2 natural cards matching the top discard)

drawDiscardReason.selectTwo: Select 2 natural cards from your hand matching the top discard
drawDiscardReason.frozen: Frozen: wild cards cannot substitute for naturals
drawDiscardReason.wildInPair: Wild cards (jokers and twos) cannot be used — pick two natural cards
drawDiscardReason.rankMismatch: Both cards must match the rank on top of the discard pile
drawDiscardReason.blackThreeTop: A black three on top blocks taking the pile

tutorial.drawArea: The stock and discard area. Draw cards from here.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Select cards to meld or discard.
tutorial.meldArea: The meld area. Your completed melds are shown here.
tutorial.actionButtons: Action buttons. Perform actions based on the current phase.

hint.meldInitial: Make your initial meld to open
hint.meldExtend: Extend an existing meld for more points
hint.discardHighSafe: Discard a high-rank card the opponent cannot use
